conclusion: Typed role separation and an acknowledgement tied to the current setup request are necessary design changes, but the existing enumerated read-root list cannot by itself preserve the ambient/read-root contract after removing WRITE_RESTRICTED. No safely complete narrow source candidate is established by these 23 files. This is a concrete implementation and coverage gap, not a request to invent an owner, grant, credential, sample, or new acceptance threshold.

original_failure_independently_rechecked.head: 9bd2f589debdba4a93baa363817c3669cb103721
original_failure_independently_rechecked.causal_boundary: The repeated outside deletion and broad Everyone ACEs are observed. Which access-check path and actual child token fields authorized each operation were not captured; do not uniquely attribute them to a new proposed token or treat parent-process token diagnostics as the child token.

minimal_required_cross_module_changes.area: Represent the full authorized read contract before materializing grants
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.fact: The typed profile can express symbolic Root/readable roots. The full-read setup collector deliberately filters the ancestor filesystem root, then supplies existing helper/platform/profile/cwd/writable roots. canonical_existing drops missing paths. That list is an ACL refresh worklist, not an exhaustive proof of every ambient normal-token-readable object.
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.change_needed: Keep symbolic all-read versus explicit read roots distinct in a trusted grant plan, preserve deny-read semantics and missing/future-path behavior, and supply an implementable normal-read-equivalent rule for platform, volume, protected-inheritance and non-filesystem startup objects before selecting a fully restricted token.
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.current_gap: Neither an exhaustive materialization/verification interface nor an already authorized and completed broader host-ACL grant set is present. Narrowing to today's worklist would silently change reads; treating symbolic Root as an instruction to relax all host ACLs is not established by this review.

minimal_required_cross_module_changes.area: Separate SID roles and current-request selection
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.fact: Current write-root selection already omits stale root capabilities. SpawnRequest carries one cap_sids vector plus a network marker; runner validates syntax/nonempty and derives token mode from the profile, but no typed current-read-grant acknowledgement is represented.
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.change_needed: Derive read, write, child-object, desktop and network roles from the existing trusted profile/root inputs; carry or independently reconstruct the same request-bound plan through setup/parent/runner. Select only current roots and preserve the existing protocol-version and authentication boundary. A caller-provided SID or digest is not proof that its ACL grant succeeded.
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.current_gap: A reusable persisted readonly SID and a flat capability vector do not represent per-root read scope, withdrawal or role-specific rights. Role labels alone do not change the kernel's alternative-SID access check.

minimal_required_cross_module_changes.area: Acknowledge actual required grants before child admission
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.fact: The original parent can wait for the exact main helper and singleflight by payload, but the main helper detaches read grants. An existing read-helper mutex skips spawning the new payload. Existing builtin or sandbox-group readability skips an ACE write. Main helper exit/SetupMarker therefore cannot acknowledge current restricting-read-SID grants.
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.change_needed: For any new full-restriction mode, have the existing authorized setup path apply and verify each required role/mask for the same request and report completion through its retained process/channel before allowing spawn. Mutex contention must join or perform the exact needed work rather than count another payload as success. Preserve deny-read ordering and propagate errors; no unrestricted or stale-success fallback.
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.current_gap: No acknowledgement contains the required current roots, roles, masks or successful grant/readback state. Adding a wait alone is insufficient, and must consume the original caller/test envelope rather than add a new timeout or retry. Existing request timings do not establish that a new exhaustive grant operation fits.

minimal_required_cross_module_changes.area: Keep read/network identities out of object and desktop write authority
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.fact: The default DACL grants GENERIC_ALL to every supplied capability SID. With Logon removed from the restricting set, the existing desktop selector copies every restricting SID and grants DESKTOP_ALL_ACCESS, including the route marker. private=false currently refuses that capability-only path.
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.change_needed: Pass a deliberately selected child-object/desktop capability set separately; do not append read SIDs to the old cap vector and do not infer desktop authority from all restricting SIDs. Preserve private=false refusal and the real private-desktop/WinSta0 launch contract, without forcing a different profile.
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.current_gap: Current constructor and desktop API only receive a token/flat vector, so there is no verified mapping that excludes read/network identities while retaining the exact authorized desktop/object principals.

minimal_required_cross_module_changes.area: Retain the established write grants, denial and runtime boundaries
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.fact: Active write-root capability grants and denial carveouts are reusable; existing IPC is established by the runner before child-token construction and stdio uses retained handles. Null-device access is explicitly granted to cap_sids. Network filtering uses a separate route marker but existing tests do not prove the final new token's ALE match.
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.change_needed: Retain original target/parent delete refusal, inside writes, denied reads, request authentication and inherited-handle isolation. Select the appropriate role for null/stdio/child-created objects and validate final-token read/startup/desktop/network behavior. Do not change WFP or normal token privileges solely to get the four-cell test green.
minimal_required_cross_module_changes.current_gap: These are dependencies of the same product contract, not authority supplied by the successful setup-handle lifecycle case. No new token has been executed, and no WFP or full-restriction compatibility success follows from this static peer.

bounded_candidate_assessment.cap_only_with_write_restricted: A narrower constructor could remove User/Logon/Everyone only from restricting identities while preserving normal identity reads. It is an independently reviewable partial tightening, but legacy_admission explicitly retains the separate parent FILE_DELETE_CHILD counterexample. Desktop role handling also needs repair. Do not present this as complete product qualification.
bounded_candidate_assessment.full_restriction_with_existing_roots_onl: Not a valid complete candidate: it silently loses ambient/read-root behavior and has no completed current read grants.
bounded_candidate_assessment.safe_next_code_scope: First make a reviewable typed grant-plan and exact helper-ack design for the existing permission profile, including the symbolic-root/ambient-read case. Keep it unselected until coverage and authorization are explicit. The available sources do not establish a complete source-local production replacement that can now be safely enabled under unchanged reads and budgets.

current_d0f_comparison.head: d0f6507e08f7f5c5855f5164d07c049a34d1a6d9
current_d0f_comparison.boundary: 19 of the 23 source blobs are identical. The two changed production files contain the separately reviewed setup handle-isolation launch and equivalent cancellation-method-pointer edits; complete diffs are retained above. The other two changed files are tests. This does not transfer any 9bd2 native result to d0f.

historical_report_clarifications: The report's 'smallest complete alternative identified' is a proposed architectural direction with unresolved read-scope and grant-ack interfaces, not a proven complete or immediately runnable repair.

The report's 'current LEAK' refers to the frozen 9bd2 original. A later source-c895 five-case run 43047914262 independently passed the original elevated env/output/exit case with 0 LEAK, while its whole job was interrupted during independent core lint. That lifecycle result does not repair or qualify the outside-delete boundary.

primary_api_contracts.use: WRITE_RESTRICTED makes restricting-SID checks write-only; the ordinary full restricted-token contract requires enabled and restricting checks.
Restricting identities participate in a separate access check; desktop and other secured-object compatibility are part of the runtime boundary.
